messages.en:
{07 00 00}Say,{01 00 00 05 00} you seem to like some
of my stuff. Let me ask
you something...
{07 0e 00}Can you tell me which ones
a kid would like?{01 00 00 05 00} One of
the "popular" kids?{02 04 00 ff ff}
Sure thing.
Not right now.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kuule,{01 00 00 05 00} sulle näib meeldivat
mõni mu asi. Las ma
küsin sinult midagi...
{07 0e 00}Kas sa oskad öelda, millised
meeldiksid lapsele?{01 00 00 05 00} Mõnele
„populaarsele” lapsele?{02 04 00 ff ff}
Muidugi.
Mitte praegu.

messages.en:
{07 15 00}All right,{01 00 00 05 00} let's get down
to brass tacks here{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 00 00}{07 15 00}Now, I know my stuff all
has a weird kinda odor to
it. I'm aware of that!
But I need to know which
piece is the MOST stinky!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Will ya tell me?{02 04 00 ff ff}
You got it!
Not right now
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Hea küll,{01 00 00 05 00} räägime nüüd
asjast{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 00 00}{07 15 00}Ma tean, et kogu mu kraam
lõhnab kuidagi imelikult.
Ma olen sellest teadlik!
Aga ma pean teadma, milline
ese on KÕIGE haisvam!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Kas sa ütled mulle?{02 04 00 ff ff}
Olgu pealegi!
Mitte praegu

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}So which piece here do you
like the most?{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 00 00}I'm just
curious, is all.{02 04 00 ff ff}
Lemme tell ya!
Buzz off!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}Nii et milline ese sulle
kõige rohkem meeldib?{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 00 00}Olen
lihtsalt uudishimulik.{02 04 00 ff ff}
Las ma ütlen!
Kasi eemale!
